offering_description.value: Owns and operates privately managed correctional, detention and reentry facilities for government agencies. Also provides electronic monitoring and community reentry programs, earning fees under government contracts.

primary_services.value: facility management; detention and correctional services; electronic monitoring; reentry programs; detainee transportation

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal immigration and corrections agencies, state and local government agencies

end_markets.value: corrections; immigration detention; behavioral health; reentry services

revenue_model.value: service fees: government payments for managing facilities and providing programs; project or contract: multi-year management contracts with government agencies; rental or leasing: government leases on facilities the company owns
revenue_model.category: service fees; project or contract; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: service provider: takes in government per-diem and contract payments, sold to federal and state agencies; asset operator: owns and runs secure facilities and monitoring operations, leased or contracted to governments

geography_served.value: US national: federal and state facilities across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: secure facility management, reentry services, electronic monitoring and behavioral health services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: contracts negotiated directly with government agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: high: operating detention facilities needs government contracts and state licensing, overseen by federal and state corrections agencies

notes: Some international operations and business lines may have changed; my description reflects my understanding of the current US business.
